decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established consumer health offer and has its own web page, so it fits the strategy of portfolio broadening and gives no sign of falling short of aspirations.
This freshly launched pharmacy supplement is actively promoted and close to the core offer, and an expanding firm has the slack to give it time to prove itself.
The joint health supplement extends the established Trivital brand at low incremental cost, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
This niche mushroom-based product gets only a mention and its results are uncertain, but it is low-cost and near the core, so slack allows keeping it for now.

The valsartan generic is distant from the firm's core, was hit by the 2018 contamination recall, and falls well below aspirations, which favours redirecting resources rather than rebuilding it in a price-competitive generic market.
